pd273_retention.presence: Copy only own present keys from the same Core-validated Payload. No defaults; absence differs from an explicit empty array.
pd273_retention.meaning: Risk is an authored declaration, not verified quality or permission. Noncritical extensions retain typed opaque SemanticValue and array order; unsupported critical semantics still reject interpretation.
pd273_retention.projection: Necessary asset declarations remain in whole_asset/exact_selection/related expand; catalog may omit declarations with not_in_mode. Preserve Host scope, error order, and complete final-body budgeting.
